$Comment: A Pumpkin Fiend Hatchling: the Pumpkin Fiend the Headless Horseman's pumpkins hatch in his graveyard as his health falls, on the normal ride (that fight's FightWaves raise it; the hard ride raises Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend_Hatchling_HM instead). Players see the same creature: it is a Variant of the wild Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend, so its look, nameplate, drop list and fight are that file's, whose comment says how it is built. Modify names only the two Parameters the wild fiend declares for its kin: twice its health (MaxHealth 60 against 30), so the fiends in his fight last long enough to matter, and FlockArray naming this role's own id. It has an id of its own so that only the fight's own fiends are in Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Adds_Group: his fight waits for that group to die before he rises and removes it when the fight resets, and a wild fiend must never hold or be swept by a fight. It never spawns in the wild. A kill pays Hallowed favor (it is in Hallows_Eve_Event_Mobs) and counts for Old Jack's fiend jobs.
